summary: The EmployerSelector is a web control used to handle employment application processes within a web application. It includes functionality for managing saved choices, placements, and provides a UI for searching and selecting employers.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing and selecting employment applications and related data.

workflows.name: Page_Load
steps: Check if the page is not a postback.

workflows.name: uxPlacements_RowCommand
steps: If cmdAdd, convert command argument to siteID.
Add employment application using UserSession, StudentID, and siteID.

workflows.name: uxSavedChoices_RowCommand
steps: If cmdDelete, convert command argument to ID and delete the application.
If cmdWithdraw, convert command argument to ID and withdraw the application.

Links are hidden from students if site recruitment is closed.

Data is bound to controls based on session and student ID.
